topic: Finding your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) in Delhi
detail: Delhi is divided into 11 legal districts, each with its own District Legal Services Authority located in the respective District Court Complex (e.g., Tis Hazari, Patiala House, Karkardooma, Rohini, Dwarka, Saket, Rouse Avenue).
how_to_find: The Delhi State Legal Services Authority (DSLSA) website (https://dslsa.org) provides a complete list of DLSA locations and their Front Offices. You can also call the DSLSA toll-free helpline at 1516.
note: For immediate legal assistance in Delhi, citizens can call 1516 or 15100. Front Offices at every DLSA are open from 10 AM to 5 PM on working days to receive applications for free legal aid.
